proposals.evidence: Full jhāṭa subsection 1 explicitly gives Gujarati jhāṛ tree/plant, Marathi jhāḍ tree and Hindi chāṛ bush alongside regional sibilant forms. These support the selected simple western jhaḍ/saḍ/chāḍ tree forms. Source affrication, sibilants, aspiration, retroflexion and final inflection remain intact; local phonetic history and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. No new Munda donor is asserted from Turner’s ultimate-origin suggestion. Exact response: dzɦaḍ.
